text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Osaka Hai, and the crowd is excited to see Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket becomes anxious about living up to her fans' expectations and racing against Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even so, she gets herself pumped to race against her rival and run a great race.
